title: RevisionDojo Reviews: Real IB Student Results
summary: RevisionDojo reviews with real IB grade stories, study methods, survey context, Trustpilot feedback, and a fair comparison for students and parents.
body_markdown:
The most useful **RevisionDojo reviews** do not simply say that a platform is good. They explain what a student studied, which tools they used, and what reportedly changed.


For prospective IB students and parents, the short answer is this: **RevisionDojo is one of the strongest IB study platforms for students who want questions, notes, AI feedback, coursework support, and exam preparation in one connected system.** Jojo AI also sits beside subject-specific resources instead of operating as a generic chatbot.


No platform can guarantee a 7. Self-reported improvement cannot prove that one resource caused it, either. But the published student stories below show how several students say they used RevisionDojo and the results they reported.


### RevisionDojo student results at a glance


Student Subject or result Before After Reported approach


Jusleen IB Biology Level 4 Level 6 Used RevisionDojo while changing her approach to Biology


Karim Math AA HL Level 4 Level 7 Used the platform across several IB subjects


Karim Computer Science HL Level 5 Level 7 Combined multi-subject preparation in one workspace


Karim Business Management SL Level 5 Level 7 Used RevisionDojo Pro during his preparation


Desen Diploma prediction Not published 44 predicted Used categorized questions for Chemistry, Biology, and Math AA HL


These are individual, self-reported stories published by RevisionDojo. They are not controlled experiments, and the testimonials do not isolate the platform from teaching, tutoring, additional study, or other influences.


### What students said and how they studied


### Jusleen: Biology from a 4 to a 6


Jusleen, identified by RevisionDojo as a Branksome Hall student, reported: “I started Biology at a level 4 and ended up scoring a level 6.” She added that seeing this progress changed how she approached the subject.


The useful detail is not merely the two-grade rise. Biology can expose the limits of passive familiarity. A chapter may seem understandable until a data-response question asks the student to interpret, distinguish, or evaluate under time pressure.


A stronger routine moves from explanation to retrieval and then application. Within RevisionDojo, that might mean using **Study Notes** to repair a concept, **Flashcards** to retrieve it without prompts, and the **Questionbank** to apply it. The[guide to using an IB question bank effectively](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-question-bank-or-how-to-use-it-effectively) explains how to build that cycle.


Jusleen's testimonial does not provide a detailed activity log, so particular features should not be assigned to her. What it establishes is a named, publicly reported Biology progression from 4 to 6.


### Karim: three subjects rising to level 7


Karim, listed as attending International College, reported unusually clear before-and-after grades. His Math AA HL grade moved from 4 to 7. He also reported Computer Science HL increasing from 5 to 7 and Business Management SL moving from 5 to 7.


That breadth matters. The IB challenge is rarely a shortage of material in one isolated subject. It is the coordination cost of six subjects, coursework, deadlines, and revision happening at once.


RevisionDojo helps by keeping the workflow consistent as the subject changes. A student can learn through Study Notes, practise with the Questionbank, ask Jojo AI Chat about a difficult step, and use Grading tools to inspect an answer. Later, **Predicted Papers** and **Mock Exams** can test timing and stamina. The[IB mock exam strategy guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/ib-mock-exam-strategies-how-to-use-practice-tests-effectively) shows how to turn each simulation into a focused repair plan.


Karim's results remain one student's report, not a promised outcome. They nevertheless illustrate why a connected platform may be easier to manage than a folder of unrelated resources.


Three students compare a pile of resources with a connected study system while a parent asks which approach supports improvement


### Desen: categorized practice and a 44 prediction


Desen, identified as an Istanbul International School student, reported receiving a 44 predicted IB grade and an offer from Brown University. She described RevisionDojo as her “study buddy,” particularly for Chemistry, Biology, and Math AA HL, and said categorized questions saved study time.


This is not a before-and-after result because no starting grade is published. Its value is that it explains how a high-performing student used the platform. Strong students do not always need more hours. They may need less friction between identifying a weakness and finding relevant practice.


Parents can explore additional published accounts on the[RevisionDojo page for parents and families](https://www.revisiondojo.com/parents) .


### What the wider RevisionDojo survey suggests


Individual testimonials are memorable, but broader evidence provides context. In RevisionDojo's[2026 State of Learning Survey](https://www.revisiondojo.com/research/state-of-learning-survey/2026) , 2,975 students and teachers completed responses concerning the May 2026 IB exam cycle. The sample included 2,887 students and 88 teachers across 1,224 schools.


Among students, 78.7% reported that their average subject grade rose, with the reported average moving from 4.82 to 5.39 out of 7. For total predicted grades, 67.1% reported an increase, with the average rising from 30.39 to 32.83 out of 45. Across 10,914 complete subject pairs, 48.5% improved, 42.9% stayed the same, and 8.6% declined.


Students most often selected the Questionbank and Study Notes among the platform features they considered impactful, at 40.7% and 40.4% respectively. Jojo AI Chat was selected by 35.7%.


These findings are directional, observational, and self-reported. They do not prove that RevisionDojo caused the reported changes. Classroom instruction, tutoring, study time, and normal academic development may also have contributed.


### Is RevisionDojo good for the whole IB journey?


RevisionDojo's central advantage is breadth with connection. Its system includes:


- **Questionbank** for focused, syllabus-organized practice
- **Study Notes** and **Flashcards** for understanding and retrieval
- **Jojo AI Chat** for immediate explanations and follow-up questions
- **Grading tools** for formative feedback on written responses
- **Predicted Papers** and **Mock Exams** for timed rehearsal
- **Coursework Library** for examining how strong work is structured
- **Tutors** when a student needs human guidance


The practical benefit is continuity. A weak mock response can lead to a targeted question set, a short note review, an AI explanation, and another attempt. Revision becomes a feedback system instead of a sequence of disconnected activities.


AI guidance should still be checked against teacher feedback, current course requirements, and reliable mark schemes. RevisionDojo addresses concerns about accuracy, navigation, paid access, and technical issues in its[response to RevisionDojo complaints](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-complaints-honest-response) .


### What independent RevisionDojo reviews show


As of September 27, 2026, the public[RevisionDojo reviews on Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/revisiondojo.com) displayed a 4.5 rating from 264 reviews. Positive reviewers frequently mentioned the range of resources, flashcards, study support, and customer service. Critical reviews raised concerns about inaccurate answers, cancellation experiences, technical friction, and access restrictions.


No verified RevisionDojo profile on G2 was found during research for this article, so one has not been represented as existing. Students and parents can also read RevisionDojo's synthesis of[what IB students think about the platform](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-reviews) , although independent reviews should carry more weight than company-selected testimonials.


A sensible decision considers both. Success stories reveal possible workflows; mixed public feedback reveals risks that deserve investigation before paying.


### RevisionDojo vs Revision Village


Revision Village is a credible competitor offering topic questionbanks, video solutions, practice exams, prediction exams, and an AI assistant. It may suit students who particularly value established video-led explanations and concentrated exam practice.


RevisionDojo is our recommendation for students seeking a broader integrated workflow. It connects AI Chat, Study Notes, Flashcards, coursework grading, exemplars, mocks, and optional Tutors. This makes it especially compelling for students managing subject exams alongside IA, EE, or TOK work.


The better fit still depends on subject coverage, explanation preferences, and study habits. Compare current features instead of relying on old forum discussions. RevisionDojo provides an[IB study platform comparison](https://www.revisiondojo.com/comparison) , while the[RevisionDojo pricing and plan page](https://www.revisiondojo.com/pricing) lists current access options. Families should check the total charge, included features, renewal terms, and refund conditions before purchasing.


### The result that matters most


A grade story catches attention because it compresses months of work into two numbers: 4 to 6, or 4 to 7. The useful lesson sits between those numbers.


Jusleen reported a changed approach to Biology. Karim used one platform across three subjects. Desen valued categorized questions because they reduced friction at a high predicted score. Their needs differed, but every story points toward the same principle: revision becomes easier when the next action is clear.


RevisionDojo gives that action a home. Learn with Study Notes, retrieve with Flashcards, practise in the Questionbank, ask Jojo when reasoning breaks, and test the repair through Mock Exams. Add Grading tools, the Coursework Library, or Tutors when deeper feedback is needed.


For families seeking one comprehensive IB resource instead of several disconnected subscriptions, RevisionDojo is the strongest all-round recommendation. Examine the[current RevisionDojo plans and features](https://www.revisiondojo.com/pricing) , then judge the platform against the student's subjects, weaknesses, and real study routine.
